page_title: PAR 0-2 INT | Parma v Inter 07/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) was probably a bit loose with his words to Andrea Colombo, who decides to show him a yellow.

90+8' 0 - 2 Marcus Thuram (Inter) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Edoardo Corvi is just a bystander as the ball flies into the right side of the goal. The score is 0:2.
90+7' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Marcus Thuram (Inter) is given a yellow card.
90+7' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Inter due to a handball in the build-up play.
90+5' Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
90+4' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
90+1' The foul by Carlos Augusto (Inter) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Andrea Colombo.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
86' Today's match ends for Mandela Keita who will be replaced by Benjamin Cremaschi (Parma).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) is coming onto the pitch as Lautaro Martinez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Luis Henrique will be replaced by Francesco Acerbi (Inter).
83' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcus Thuram (Inter) comes onto the pitch for Francesco Pio Esposito.
75' Substitution. Mateo Pellegrino makes his way off the pitch and Patrick Cutrone (Parma) comes on as his replacement.
75' Carlos Cuesta has decided to make a change. Nahuel Estevez (Parma) replaces Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
75' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
73' The corner is swung in but Parma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Cristian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Piotr Zielinski (Inter) replacing Hakan Calhanoglu.
69' Substitution. Petar Sucic will be replaced by Nicolo Barella (Inter).
68' Petar Sucic (Inter) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.

64' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Edoardo Corvi easily catches the ball.
62' Carlos Cuesta prepares a substitution. Jacob Ondrejka is replaced by Christian Ordonez (Parma).
62' It's time for a substitution. Pontus Almqvist (Parma) comes on in place of Gaetano Oristanio.
62' The corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is cleared away by the defence.
61' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
57' A pass from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is intercepted by Edoardo Corvi and the move breaks down.

54' Petar Sucic (Inter) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Edoardo Corvi, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
52' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
49' Neat passing move from Inter in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

45' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Andrea Colombo signals that the goal stands! The Inter players celebrate. Federico Dimarco (Inter) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
43' Attention! Referee Andrea Colombo straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
42' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Federico Dimarco (Inter) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

41' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Edoardo Corvi pulls off a brilliant save.
40' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
39' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) leaps highest and connects well with a cross, but his header towards the middle of the goal is well saved by Edoardo Corvi.
38' A huge rebound finds Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) unmarked on the edge of the box. He lines up a shot but slips just before he hits it and sends the ball miles wide of the left post.
37' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
35' Carlos Augusto (Inter) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Edoardo Corvi, who smothers the ball.
34' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
32' OFF THE BAR! Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball crashes against the crossbar.
32' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Carlos Augusto (Inter), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
30' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
29' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.

28' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
24' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and it's Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
22' The corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is hurriedly cleared.

19' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header, but sent the ball into the stands.
17' What a chance that is! Federico Dimarco swings the ball into the box, and Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar.
14' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

14' What a great touch by Yann Bisseck (Inter) after latching on to a precise pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and rips a shot towards the top left corner. The goalkeeper makes an astonishing save, knocking the ball onto the post. Now Inter have a corner.
11' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) gets on the end of a lofted pass but can only head straight at Edoardo Corvi, who fumbles and makes the save at the second attempt.
8' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
3' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
